product.facts.composition_scope.constant: partial unordered disclosure; other ingredients not excluded

product.facts.analytical_basis.constant: label percent of food as sold

adult_pouch.composition: meat and animal derivatives, cereals, oils and fats, vegetable derivatives, minerals and yeast

puppy_can.composition: chicken, potatoes, carrots, salmon oil, minerals and botanicals
puppy_can.normalization: nutrition Calorie convention: one nutrition Calorie is one kcal

adult_topper.composition: chicken breast, lamb, potato starch and vegetable gelling agent
adult_topper.normalization: per-kilogram energy divided by ten for a 100g basis
adult_topper.dispensing: tipping pieces and gravy from the can

steps.derive: 'tearing the pouch notch' if product.facts.container == 'pouch' else ('lifting the can ring-pull' if applicable(product.facts.can_hardware) and product.facts.can_hardware == 'ring-pull' else 'opening the can with a can opener')
'ordinary meals in its usual bowl' if known(product.facts.dietary_role) and product.facts.dietary_role == 'complete' else 'small servings alongside its usual complete food in its usual bowl'
